data.title: Reverse Engineering Circular Dimensions
data.description: Engage in critical analysis by working backward from known circumferences and areas to deduce underlying radii. Apply algebraic reasoning to solve complex geometric challenges in real-world contexts.

challenges.narration: A circular pool has the circumference shown.
challenges.instruction: The circumference is given. Work backward to find the radius.
challenges.hint: C = 2 × π × r, so r = C ÷ (2 × π). Divide by 2 × 3.14.

challenges.narration: A round mirror has the area shown.
challenges.instruction: The area is given. Work backward to find the radius.
challenges.hint: A = π × r², so r = √(A ÷ π). Divide by 3.14, then take the square root.

challenges.narration: A ferris wheel has the area shown.
challenges.instruction: The area is given. Work backward to find the radius.
challenges.hint: A = π × r², so r = √(A ÷ π). Divide by 3.14, then take the square root.
